got.visual_110s: In-game night scene with characters and fire, dark/missing fill; overlay 3 FPS / 387.8 ms. Control and sustained performance are not established.
got.errors: 3152 wave-limit stub calls account for most error lines; these are not crash reports.
got.conclusion: Native capture supports the tiny-mip fix and shows progression beyond the prior crash. Missing fill and usable frame rate remain unresolved.

gow.shutdown_thread: SDLAudioP43, D state, dma_fence_wait_any_timeout; main zombie
gow.shutdown_interpretation: Process was not gone within the capture deadline; permanent hang or an Audio3D cause is not established.
gow.image_readback_scope_note: Demand checks, not 23 million actual image downloads.

integration.upstream_change: Upstream PR5134: deferred V_MOVREL lowering with SSA bounds analysis; avoids frontend full register-range unrolling. Native impact is unverified.
integration.tree_checks: All 52 published trees equal local rebased trees.
integration.conflicts: One CMake conflict resolved by retaining both new lower_movrel_pass and ordered_gds_continuation_pass source entries.

diagnostic_change.purpose: Distinguish buffer/image tracking and none/read/read-write permission transitions. Existing aggregation did not identify the source of 8.28 million protection calls.
diagnostic_change.sampling: First eight and powers of two; six event buckets. Exact aggregate event counts are dumped at normal process exit. Forced termination may leave only sampled lower bounds.
diagnostic_change.forwarding: Original address, size, permissions and one backend Protect call are preserved, in the same locked positions. No batching, coherence semantics or syscall policy change.
diagnostic_change.when_disabled: No trace or diagnostic counter updates.

validation.cpu_suite: PASS 31 CTests, 7 renderer contracts, production SRT and sparse tests, descriptor, VMA and guest ABI checks
validation.retained_shader_regression: Four original 320-access kernels, Vulkan 1.3 SPIR-V validation, 16 interpreter cases / 8704 output word checks pass with current upstream recompiler objects.
validation.handoff: Three substituted-boundary cases: success, bad checksum, download failure.
validation.source_bytes: All src files match the successful full build checkout.
